=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2970-2980 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The provenance check in _verify_resolution_provenance compares whole lines after whitespace normalisation (`provenant = {norm(line) ...}`), so it rejects as foreign any correct resolution that combines both branches' edits into one line, for example a case pattern, a one-line list or an argument list; the retry prelude (prompts/conflict-resolver-retry-provenance-prelude.txt lines 11-16: "only lines taken from ours ... or a combination of both sides' lines") contradicts the check.
  WHY: Such a merge was committed before this PR; now it either gets forced into one side's line, which silently drops the other branch's edit and passes every gate, or it escalates with `RESOLVER_TERMINAL_EXIT_CLASS="provenance"` and `exit 1` (lines 4657-4665). Severity disagreement: MAJOR from sonnet, gemini, minimax and luna; NIT from glm. glm says this matches the plan's line-level union spec (plan line 245), so the check should not be softened without a plan revision. Sonnet proposes a prelude-only fix: tell the model to stack both variants as separate lines.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2619-2620,2997-3000 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The verifier appends `"\n(truncated)\n"` after a 16384-byte REPORT_CAP slice, but `_build_retry_prompt` reads only `head -c 16384`, so the truncation marker is lost exactly when truncation happened.
  WHY: The retry prompt ends mid-list with no sign that regions were left out, so the model fixes only the listed hunks and fails provenance again, and the run escalates with exit_class=provenance; test_report_is_truncated_at_16_kib checks the file, not the rendered prompt. All reviewers rated this NIT.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2620,2982-2999 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A model-resolved line containing `--- END UNTRUSTED PROVENANCE REPORT ---` is written verbatim into the provenance report (`body.append("+" + added.decode(...))`) and re-emitted inside the prelude's UNTRUSTED fence (prompts/conflict-resolver-retry-provenance-prelude.txt lines 19-23), which closes the fence early.
  WHY: Report content after the early fence close is read as trusted instructions on the retry pass. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from minimax, NIT from glm. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this: every model-derived line starts with "+", so it cannot reproduce the bare fence line.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2636 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The untrusted provenance report text ("--- END UNTRUSTED PROVENANCE REPORT ---") can be spoofed by the model and close the UNTRUSTED fence early in the retry prompt (inline provenance header).
  WHY: A malicious or confused model can break the fence that protects the retry-prompt context, which can lead to prompt injection (gemini rated it MAJOR; kept separate from the 2620/2982-2999 entry because the cited lines do not overlap).
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2881-2899 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `os.lstat(path)` and `O_NOFOLLOW` in the Python verifier guard only the last path component, so a symlinked parent directory is followed and files outside the merge working tree are read.
  WHY: Content from outside the tree, or foreign lines, can leak into RESOLVER_PROVENANCE_REPORT_FILE and the retry prompt. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from minimax, NIT from gemini. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this: the sandbox transfer already rejects symlink_path and symlink_in_path (scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:4172).
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:727-736,4657-4660 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `RESOLVER_PROVENANCE_RETRY_MAX` clamp accepts `0*[0-2]`, so a value of 2 allows two provenance retries, because `_resolver_provenance_failures -gt "${RESOLVER_PROVENANCE_RETRY_MAX}"` is false at 2.
  WHY: The plan (docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md:243-253) says "Allow at most one provenance retry per run"; a value of 2 spends an extra model attempt before escalating. Severity disagreement: MAJOR from minimax, NIT from luna and glm. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this: the default is 1, and the knob is script-only and not set by the workflow.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:4670-4672 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The provenance-failure retry branch runs only after fingerprints passed, yet it copies RESOLVER_FP_VIOLATIONS_FILE (empty or stale) over RESOLVER_FP_VIOLATIONS_PREV_FILE.
  WHY: The next attempt's no-progress check (around line 4727, guarded by `[ -s ... ]`) is skipped, so a fingerprint → provenance → fingerprint sequence spends an extra model retry instead of escalating. All three rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this: line 4817 copies the same way, and an empty baseline is the correct record.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:720 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The settings comment says "relative to the diff3 merge", but the implementation deliberately uses the two-sided `git -c merge.conflictStyle=merge merge-file -p`.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but a maintainer who aligns the code with the comment would bring back the base-only blind spot that test_invented_or_base_only_line_is_foreign[base_only] guards. All rated it NIT.
- agents.md:4631 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The contractual RESOLVER_TERMINAL registry enum `exit_class=<ok|timeout|no_progress|markers|fingerprint|scope|commit|other>` does not list `provenance`, which the script now emits (scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:524 and :4664); the agents.d/9842-resolver-provenance.md fragment does not update it either.
  WHY: Consumers written against the documented enum will treat `exit_class=provenance` as unknown. agents.md is outside the PR's files_touched grant, so the fix must be routed deliberately. All rated it NIT.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2631-2639 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The inline provenance fallback in `_build_retry_prompt` omits the staged template's "All constraints from the main task below still apply." line and the `=== ORIGINAL TASK ===` separator (prompts/conflict-resolver-retry-provenance-prelude.txt:25-28).
  WHY: When the prelude is not staged, the report runs straight into the original task text and retries become less consistent. Sonnet and glm raised the same point as hardening suggestions only.

- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh (plus prompts/conflict-resolver-retry-provenance-prelude.txt lines 11-16) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The whole-line provenance check (`provenant = {norm(line) for line in blobs["stage2"].split(b"\n")}`) always counts a correct same-line combination of both branches' edits as foreign, for example line 524's case pattern.
  WHY: Either the model follows the prelude and keeps one side's line, which silently loses the other edit, or it keeps the correct combined line and the run ends with `RESOLVER_TERMINAL_EXIT_CLASS="provenance"` and `exit 1` (lines 4657-4665). Suggested in-scope fix: change the prelude to stack both variants as separate lines.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A truncated report can be up to 16384+13 bytes, but `_prov_report="$(head -c 16384 -- "${_prov_report_file}" ...)"` drops the "(truncated)" marker.
  WHY: The retry prompt ends mid-list with no sign that regions were omitted, so the run escalates; test_report_is_truncated_at_16_kib does not check the rendered prompt.

  PROBLEM: Line 4631, the RESOLVER_TERMINAL registry, still lists `exit_class=<ok|timeout|no_progress|markers|fingerprint|scope|commit|other>` without `provenance` (scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:524 and :4664); the fragment mentions it only in prose.
  WHY: External consumers would treat `provenance` as unknown; agents.md is not in the plan grant.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The header comment at line ~720 says "diff3 merge", but the code uses the two-sided `git -c merge.conflictStyle=merge merge-file -p`.
  WHY: No runtime failure; aligning the code with the comment would bring back the base-only blind spot.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh, `_build_retry_prompt` inline fallback: the "All constraints from the main task below still apply." line and the "=== ORIGINAL TASK ===" separator are missing; 1-line fix. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
